blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/
blocks.zh: 边疆视频生成模型在VAE潜在空间中工作,在空间和时间上压缩视频. 这种压缩使得训练可以进行,但现在限制了高分辨率,可控,交互的生成——双倍分辨率四重奏符号计数,条件适用于各种帧而不是单个帧,每个响应必须等待其多帧块的其余部分. 我们提出 PixVid,是一种简单而有效的方法,可以提升一个预先训练过的潜伏视频模型,直接生成像素空间中的每个帧. 像素 Vid保持扩散变压器,并用一个使输出成像素的转录头取代VAE解码器. 我们认为,预测干净的视频而不是速度,加上更大的噪音变化,是质量的关键。 PixVid从Wan2.1-14B的微调中,在1.3M美元培训剪辑中具有潜在基线的竞争力。 工作帧在像素中,以2\times$更高分辨率生成,每帧符号计数相同,保持深度条件视频编辑在快速运动下对齐,并在下一个帧中响应每个动作. 项目网页:https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Early video diffusion models [ 32 , 30 ] generated videos in their native form, as sequences of pixel frames.
As models scaled up, the field made two shifts away from pixel space:
The first followed latent diffusion [ 72 ] , moving generation into the latent space of a pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) [ 48 ] , initially with one latent per frame [ 7 , 6 ] .
The second extended the compression to time, using 3D VAEs to merge every few frames into a single latent that corresponds to no individual frame [ 93 , 85 ] .
For generating short clips offline at moderate resolution, this was a favorable trade: compression made training tractable at scale, at the cost of a frozen VAE that ruled out end-to-end training and capped quality at its reconstruction [ 14 , 23 , 77 ] .
blocks.zh:
早期的视频传播模型[32,30]以原生的形式生成了视频,作为像素帧的序列.
随着模型的扩大,球场从像素空间中进行了两处转变:
第一个是潜在的扩散[72],将一代移入预先训练的可变自编码器(VAE)[48]的潜在空间,最初每个框架有一个潜在的[7,6]。
第二种将压缩扩展到了时间,使用3D VAE将每几个帧合并成一个单一的潜伏,不对应单个帧[93.,85].
由于在中度分辨率下线生成短片,这是一个有利的交易:压缩使培训可以大规模地进行,其代价是冻结的VAE排除了端到端培训和在重建时的上限质量[14、23、77]。

blocks.en:
Video generation models have since outgrown this setting: they now power real-time interactive world models [ 27 , 79 , 33 ] through causal few-step distillation [ 97 , 38 ] , and serve as geometry-conditioned renderers for editing and games [ 43 , 62 , 63 ] .
Yet these systems inherit the VAE’s fixed compression in space and time, which works against each new demand.
Under a real-time compute budget, doubling the resolution yields 4 × 4\times more tokens and 16 × 16\times more attention compute, while cutting tokens requires a more aggressive VAE that further reduces quality.
Precise editing requires conditions aligned to individual frames, but when several frames share one latent, fast motion blurs and objects deform (Fig. 5 ).
Temporal compression also limits responsiveness. Since common latent world models [ 97 , 38 , 92 , 27 , 79 , 37 ] autoregressively generate frames in blocks, the frame corresponding to a control cannot be generated until all controls for the full block are received. This results in a minimum control-to-screen latency proportional to the block size, a barrier that no model-side optimization can remove.
blocks.zh:
从那时起,视频生成模型就已经超越了这一设定:它们现在通过因果的几步分馏[97,38],为实时互动世界模型[27,79,33]提供动力,并作为编辑和游戏的几何条件的渲染器[43,62,63].
然而,这些系统继承了VAE在空间和时间上的固定压缩,这与每一个新的需求相悖。
在实时计算预算下,将分辨率翻一番后,会产生4×4\的多兆分,16×16相多兆分;而剪接符则需要更积极的VAE来进一步降低质量.
精确编辑需要与单个帧对齐的条件,但当多个帧共享一个潜伏,快动模糊和对象变形(图5.
时间压缩也限制了反应能力. 由于常见的潜在世界模型[97, 38, 92, 27, 79, 37] 以块为单位自相递地生成帧, 在收到全部块的所有控制之前,无法生成对应一个控制的框架. 这导致了与块大小成正比的最小控制到屏幕的空闲度,一个模型-侧优化无法去除的屏障.

blocks.en:
These limitations motivate removing the VAE altogether and generating every frame directly as pixels, which naively would bring back the token counts and training costs that latent models avoid.
Recent pixel-space image models overcome both challenges [ 50 , 98 , 19 , 18 , 41 , 13 ] by modeling semantics over large pixel patches [ 50 ] and delegating fine details to a lightweight decoder [ 19 ] , thus keeping the token count and training cost reasonable.
Moreover, although training video models from scratch demands prohibitive data and compute resources, a pretrained latent model already captures high-level semantics and dynamics. Hence, finetuning it into a pixel space video model only requires changing the output interface, which is a more feasible task.
blocks.zh:
这些限制促使将VAE完全删除,并直接生成每个帧作为像素,这天真地会带回潜在的模型所避免的象征性计数和培训成本.
最近的像素-空间图像模型克服了两个挑战[50,98,19,18,41,13],在大型像素补丁上建模语义 [50],并将细微细节委托给轻量级解码器[19],从而保持了符号计数和培训成本的合理性.
此外,虽然从头开始培训视频模型需要令人望而却步的数据和计算资源,但经过预先培训的潜在模型已经掌握了高级语义和动态。 因此,将它微调为像素空间视频模型只需要改变输出界面,这是一个更可行的任务.

blocks.en:
In this work, we present PixVid , a recipe that lifts a pretrained latent video diffusion model into a frame-wise pixel-space model, in which every token covers a 1 × p × p 1\times p\times p patch of exactly one frame, so no condition or action spans multiple frames.
PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer (DiT) and replaces both the encoder and the decoder from the VAE (Fig. 2 ).
At input, a patch embedding that initializes from the VAE encoder allows the
DiT to start training from close to its pretrained latent distribution.
At output, a lightweight detailer head renders the DiT tokens into pixels; it is convolutional to suppress the patch-grid artifacts of a linear head [ 88 ] , and causal in time to allow autoregressive generation.
We further identify the following key techniques: 1) predicting clean video ( x x -prediction) rather than velocity, since velocity prediction forces the network to model full-rank per-pixel noise [ 50 ] ; 2) using a larger noise shift, since redundant pixels retain more signal at the same noise level; and 3) using the Euler sampler, since pixel color values are numerically sensitive to higher order solvers like UniPC [ 101 ] .

在这部作品中,我们呈现出PixVid ——一种将预先训练过的潜在视频传播模型提升到帧-像素-空间模型的配方,其中每个符物覆盖1×p×p 1\times p\times 完全一个帧的补丁,所以没有条件或动作跨越多帧.
PixVid保留了扩散变压器(DiT)并取代了从VAE(图2.

DiT从接近其被预先训练的潜在分布开始训练.
在输出时,一个轻量级的细头会使 DiT 令牌变成像素;压制线头的补丁-网格文物[88],以及时间上的因果,允许自旋生成.
我们进一步确定了以下关键技术: 1) 预测干净的视频(x-预测)而不是速度,因为速度预测迫使网络对每个像素的全能噪声进行建模[50];2) 使用更大的噪声变化,因为冗余像素在同一噪声水平上保留了更多的信号;3) 使用Euler采样器,因为像素的颜色值在数字上对UniPC等更高排序解析器敏感 [101].

blocks.en:
Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B [ 85 ] , PixVid converges within 1.3 1.3 M training clips sampled from 64 64 K videos, or about 4 4 K B200 GPU-hours. It achieves competitive quality with the original latent model on VBench [ 39 ] , and the recipe transfers across Wan2.1 and Wan2.2-based models with different VAEs.
Generating frame by frame in pixels, it introduces several benefits, as shown in Fig. 1 . Resolution: doubling the patch size lets PixVid generate 960 × 1664 960\times 1664 with the same number of tokens per frame as at 480 × 832 480\times 832 . Control: with the same control branch as the latent model, depth-conditioned editing keeps 98 % 98\% of the source’s fast motion, versus 83 % 83\% for an identically finetuned latent model. Latency: after autoregressive distillation, each camera control takes effect at the next frame rather than the next block, cutting median latency from 495 495 ms to 34 34 ms while still streaming in real time.
blocks.zh:
微调自 Wan2.1-14B [85],PixVid在从64个64K视频中抽取的1.3个M训练片段内汇合,或约4个K B200 GPU-hours. 它通过V Bench [39] 上的原始潜入模型实现竞争质量,而食谱则通过基于Wan2.1和Wan2.2的模型与不同的VAE进行转移.
以像素为框架生成帧,它引入了几个好处,如Fig所示. 1,分辨率:将补丁大小翻倍,使PixVid生成960×1664 960\times 1664,每个帧的令牌数量与480×832 480\times 832相同. 控制:使用与潜在模型相同的控制分支,深度条件编辑保留了源快速运动的98%-98 %,而83 %-83 %是一个相同的微调潜在模型。 纬度:自相回向蒸馏后,相机的每个控制在下个相框而不是下个相框上生效,将中位纬度从495 495 ms削减到34 34 ms的同时仍能实时流出.

blocks.en: To summarize, our main contributions are as follows: • We propose PixVid , a recipe that lifts a pretrained latent video diffusion model into a frame-wise pixel-space model, converging quickly to competitive quality. • We identify the design choices that make this lift work: a causal convolutional detailer head with 9 × 9\times fewer patch seams than a linear head, x x -prediction with 80 × 80\times less pixel noise than v v -prediction, and a larger noise shift than the latent model. • We show frame-wise pixel generation overcomes three structural limitations of latent models: resolution scaling, control alignment under fast motion, and control-to-screen latency.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提议PixVid,一种将预先训练的潜在视频传播模型提升到帧-像素-空间模型的配方,迅速与竞争性质量相汇合。 我们确定使这个升起工作的设计选择:一个因果分解器头,与线形头相比,补丁接缝少了9×9分;x××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××-××××××××××××-×××××××××××××××××××××-×××××××××××等同位素噪声小于v-预测;与潜入型相比,噪音变化较大. 我们显示基于帧的像素生成克服了潜在模型的三个结构局限性:分辨率缩放,快速运动下的控制对接,以及控制到屏幕的空闲。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Pixel-Space Diffusion. Latent diffusion [ 72 , 68 , 7 ] has been favored for efficient training using spatial and temporal compression for video [ 93 , 85 , 8 ] , at the price of a VAE reconstruction bottleneck. Pixel-space diffusion models for images [ 29 , 78 , 22 , 46 ] and videos [ 32 , 30 , 76 , 5 ] bypass a VAE but become costly at high resolution, historically requiring cascaded or multi-resolution designs [ 31 , 74 , 71 , 26 , 20 , 81 ] . Recent methods improved pixel-space image generation, training from scratch [ 34 , 35 , 15 , 50 , 98 , 19 , 58 , 87 , 55 , 57 , 13 , 61 ] or finetuning from latent checkpoints to make training tenable [ 18 , 41 , 13 ] .
Pixel-space video generation is less explored. Concurrent works train from scratch, and they either focus on smaller class-conditioned benchmarks [ 84 ] or have undesirable patch artifacts [ 88 ] . We finetune a pretrained latent video model, inheriting its prior capabilities and maintaining competitive quality.
blocks.zh:
像素-空间传播. 积极传播[72.、68.、7]已受到青睐,以VAE重建瓶颈为代价,利用视频的时空压缩进行高效培训[93.、85.、8]。 图像[29.,78.,22.,46]和视频[32.,30.,76.,5]的像素-空间传播模型绕过一个甚高分辨率,但费用很高,历史上需要级联或多分辨率设计[31.,74.,71.,26.,20.,81]. 近期方法改进了像素-空间图像生成,从零开始培训[34、35、15、50、98、19、58、87、55、57、13、61]或从潜在检查站微调,使培训变得可行[18、41、13]。
像素空间视频生成的探索较少. 同时期工程列车从零开始,它们要么侧重于更小的有阶级条件的基准[84],要么有不受欢迎的补丁文物[88]. 我们调整了一种事先经过培训的潜在视频模型,继承其先前的能力并保持竞争力。

blocks.en: Controllable Video Generation and Editing. Early video editors applied image diffusion models with heuristics such as cross-frame shared self-attention [ 89 , 70 , 47 , 24 ] or propagated edits [ 4 , 91 , 67 ] . Video diffusion models improve consistency and robustness, with recent models producing precise, aligned edits and structure-guided generation [ 43 , 94 , 45 , 62 , 49 , 73 , 10 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 可控视频生成与编辑. 早期的视频编辑应用了图像传播模型,带有跨帧共享自意等热度[89.,70.,47.,24]或被传播编辑[4.,91.,67]. 视频传播模式提高了一致性和稳健性,最近的模式产生了精确、一致的编辑和结构指导生成[43、94、45、62、49、73、10、25]。

blocks.en:
Interactive Video Generation. Interactive generation produces frames as a stream, typically with autoregressive video diffusion models [ 11 , 21 , 90 , 80 , 12 ] . Combined with few-step distillation [ 96 , 95 , 97 , 38 , 92 , 104 , 17 ] , latent world models respond to user actions across diverse scenes in real time [ 27 , 60 , 79 , 33 ] ,
but temporal compression delays each action, e.g . by up to three frames for Wan’s four-frame latents [ 85 ] .
Per-frame latent [ 9 , 83 ] and pixel-space [ 2 , 65 ] world models avoid this delay but are trained from scratch on a single genre. PixVid is finetuned from a general pretrained model and responds to actions at the next frame.
blocks.zh:
互动视频世代. 互动世代作为一流产生帧,一般采用自旋式视频传播模式[11,21,90,80,12]. 结合几步蒸馏[96、95、97、38、92、104、17],潜在世界模型实时应对不同场景的用户行为[27、60、79、33],
但时间压缩会延迟每个动作,例如. 最多三帧的Wan的四帧潜质 [85] 。
每个框架的潜在[9,83]和像素-空间[2,65]世界模型避免了这种延迟,但从头到尾在单一流派上加以训练。 PixVid从一般的预训模型中微调出并响应下帧的动作.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
Our goal is to generate every frame directly in pixels without training a pixel-space video model from scratch, while removing the VAE bottleneck.
PixVid achieves this by lifting a pretrained latent video diffusion model into a frame-wise pixel-space model, as shown in Fig. 2 .
We describe its architecture in Sec. 3.1 and how we train it from the latent model in Sec. 3.2 , including key design choices.
We then adapt it to efficient high-resolution generation in Sec. 3.3 , precise video editing in Sec. 3.4 , and low-latency autoregressive generation in Sec. 3.5 .
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是在不从零开始训练像素-空间视频模型的情况下,直接用像素生成每个帧,同时去除VAE瓶颈.
PixVid通过将一个预先被训练出的潜在视频扩散模型提升到一个帧相像素-空间模型来实现这一点,如图2所显示.
我们在第3.1节中描述了它的架构,以及我们如何从第3.2节的潜在模型中对其进行培训,包括关键的设计选择。
然后,我们根据3.3节的高效高分辨率生成,3.4节的精确视频编辑,3.5节的低纬度自递性生成。

blocks.en: 3.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑

blocks.en: PixVid keeps the DiT [ 68 ] backbone of a pretrained latent video model and replaces the VAE: a linear patch embedding maps pixels to tokens, and a lightweight convolutional detailer head renders the DiT outputs directly into pixels.
blocks.zh: PixVid保留了预先被训练出潜伏视频模型的DiT [68]主干并取代了VAE:线性补丁嵌入了像素到符号上,而轻量级的分解器头会使DiT输出直接变成像素.

blocks.en:
Frame-Wise Tokenization. Latent video models merge several frames into one latent [ 93 , 85 ] , so conditions apply to groups of frames.
PixVid instead gives each frame its own tokens, each covering a 1 × p × p 1\times p\times p pixel patch.
Conditions then align with individual frames, and an autoregressive model can respond to actions at the next frame.
Although this approach uses more tokens per clip than with temporal compression, the spatial token count does not grow with resolution as it is determined by the adjustable patch size rather than a frozen VAE.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2017-10-21). Framewise Tokenization. Latent视频模型将多帧合并为一潜在 [93,85],因此条件适用于帧组.
PixVid转而给出了每个帧自己的活符,每个活符覆盖了1×p×p1\times活像素补丁.
条件随后与单个帧相适应,自旋模式可以在下一个帧中响应动作.
虽然这种方法使用每个片段的符号比用时间压缩时多,但空间符号计数并不随分辨率而增长,因为它是由可调整的补丁大小而不是被冻结的VAE所决定.

blocks.en:
Detailer Head. Since the DiT captures global structure and leaves only local details to render, we implement the detailer as a lightweight 3D convolutional decoder, sharing this insight with pixel-space image models [ 19 , 18 , 41 ] .
Unlike their U-Net detailers, which also encode the noisy pixels of each patch, ours keeps only the decoder path and reads only the DiT tokens.
It stacks L = log 2 ⁡ p L=\log_{2}p up blocks, each upsampling by 1 × 2 × 2 1\times 2\times 2 , so the head maps each token to a 1 × p × p 1\times p\times p pixel patch and predicts the clean video.
Its convolutions also run across neighboring tokens rather than within each patch, which largely suppresses checkerboard artifacts at token boundaries.
They are causal in time, so the detailer models local temporal structure without reading future frames and supports frame-by-frame generation.
See App. A.2 for details.

Initialization. To retain the pretrained latent model’s prior, we inherit its DiT weights and randomly initialize the detailer head.
Following AsymFlow [ 13 ] , we approximate the VAE encoder with a linear map 𝑨 \bm{A} fitted offline between pixel patches and their latents, and compose it with the pretrained patch embedding to initialize the pixel patch embedding.
We further employ an internal timestep calibration, with scale c c estimated alongside 𝑨 \bm{A} , to ensure the signal-to-noise ratios of latent and pixel spaces are aligned. The DiT thus initially receives inputs close to the latents it was trained on. Full details appear in App. A.1 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Efficient High-Resolution Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 高效高分辨率生成

blocks.en:
The high-level semantic content of a video changes little with resolution, so higher resolution should mainly require finer rendering, not more tokens.
A latent DiT cannot exploit this, as doubling the resolution yields 4 × 4\times more latent tokens.
PixVid instead doubles the patch size from p p to 2 ​ p 2p and adds one up block to the detailer, keeping the token grid unchanged (Fig. 3 ).
Unlike PixelDiT [ 98 ] , whose token count grows with resolution, or DiP [ 19 ] and L2P [ 18 ] , which add no detailer levels, this gives the doubled resolution its own upsampling level without much additional cost.

视频的高层次语义内容随分辨率变化不大,因此更高分辨率应主要需要更精细的渲染,而不是更多的符号.
潜伏的 DiT 无法利用这一点, 因为将分辨率翻倍 4× 4\ times 的潜伏符号 。
PixVid转而将补丁大小从p翻倍到2p,再将一个上方块加到细节上,使令牌网格保持不变(图3).
不同于PixelDIT [98],其符号计数随分辨率而增长,或者DiP [19]和L2P [18],它们没有增加更详尽的分数,这使得分数翻了一倍的分数本身的取出分数分数,而没有增加很多成本.

blocks.en: 3.4 Precise Video Editing
blocks.zh: 3.4 精准视频编辑

blocks.en:
Precise video editing, such as re-rendering a video from its per-frame depth, requires the generated video to align with the condition at every frame.
Latent models typically encode the condition with the same VAE as the video [ 43 ] , so several condition frames share one latent, leading to inaccurate alignment, especially in fast motions.
In PixVid, the condition is tokenized per frame as the corresponding video, so generation and condition are aligned at the frame level, without changing the conditioning mechanism.
Concretely, we add the control branch of VACE [ 43 ] : conditions are residually added to the DiT tokens via control blocks, and the condition’s patch embedding is initialized, like the video’s, by fusing the pretrained embedding with 𝑨 \bm{A} .
blocks.zh:
精准的视频编辑,如从每帧深度重新发送一段视频,需要生成的视频与每个帧的条件一致.
Latetnt模型一般用和视频相同的VAE编码条件[43],因此几个条件框架共享一个潜伏,导致不准确的对接,特别是在快速运动中.
在"PixVid"中,条件被每个帧作为对应的视频标出,因此生成和条件在帧级别对齐,而不会改变调节机制.
具体地说,我们加入了VACE [43] 的控制分支:通过控制块将条件剩余地添加到 DiT 令牌中,并且条件的补丁嵌入像视频一样被初始化,通过将预训嵌入用 A\bm{A} 来将预训嵌入来进行引信.

blocks.en: 3.5 Low-Latency Autoregressive Generation
blocks.zh: 3.5 低密度自动递减生成

blocks.en:
Interactive applications stream video in response to user controls, such as camera or motion inputs, and should react to each control as soon as it arrives.
An autoregressive model generates video in blocks, and a block can start only once the controls for all its frames have arrived.
In a temporally compressed latent model, each block spans at least one latent, i.e . , several frames, so a new control waits for the rest of its block, a delay that no throughput-side optimization can remove (Fig. 6 ).
PixVid can generate single-frame blocks, so each control takes effect at the next frame.
To achieve this, we lift a bidirectional latent model to pixel space with the recipe above and distill it into a few-step causal model with Self Forcing [ 38 ] .
The causal detailer decodes one frame at a time from cached features of previous frames, keeping its cost per frame constant.
Single-frame blocks trade some throughput for this latency gain, which we analyze in Sec. 4.5 .
blocks.zh:
互动应用程序流视频,以响应用户控制,如相机或动作输入,并应当在每个控制到达后立即响应.
自动后退模型生成以块为单位的视频,而一个块只有在其所有帧的控件到达后才能启动.
在一个时间上压缩后的潜在模型中,每个块至少会跨出一个潜伏,即:多帧,所以一个新的控制等待其块的其余部分,这个延迟是任何吞吐量-侧优化都无法去除的(图6).
PixVid可以生成单帧块,因此每个控制在下帧生效.
为了实现这一点,我们举出一个双向潜入模型,用上面的食谱来像素空间,并用Self Forcing[38]将它分馏成几步的因果模型.
因果详解器一次从前作帧的缓存特征中解码出一帧,保持每帧成本不变.
单帧区块用一定的吞吐量来换取这一暂时性收益,我们在4.5号案对此进行了分析。

Setup. We add the control branch of VACE [ 43 ] to PixVid-1.3B and finetune it to re-render a video from its per-frame depth and a caption.
We compare with VACE-1.3B, finetuned with the same control branch, data, and training settings;

We train on 79 79 K stock videos with varied camera and object motion and paired depth [ 16 ] , and evaluate on 1,000 1{,}000 held-out clips across alignment, temporal fidelity, and video quality.

blocks.en:
Setup. We lift the bidirectional SolarWM-5B base [ 37 ] into pixel space and distill it with Self Forcing [ 38 ] into a 4 4 -step causal student that generates one frame per block.
We compare with the official causal student distilled from the same base, referred to as SolarWM, which generates blocks of 12 12 frames ( 3 3 latents).
We evaluate quality and camera following on camera paths from nine public datasets, and responsiveness on abrupt turns, measuring how closely the generated motion follows each control (App. B.5 ).
We measure control-to-screen latency, which includes both the wait for controls from the same block and the model’s generation time. We time both models on one B200 GPU with the same kernels.
blocks.zh:
设相. 我们把双向SolarWM-5B基座[37]升入像素空间,并用"Self Forcing [38]"蒸馏成一个每块产生一帧的4个4步因子.
我们比较了官方因子学生从同一种碱基中分出,称为SolarWM,生成12个12帧(3个3个潜伏物)的区块.
我们评价9个公共数据集的相机路径的质量和相机,以及突然转弯时的反应,衡量产生的运动如何紧跟每个控制(App.B.5)。
我们测量控制到屏幕的间隔,这既包括等待同一个区块的控制,也包括模型的生成时间。 我们用同一个内核的B200GPU来计算两个模型的时间.

blocks.en:
Results. PixVid cuts median control-to-screen latency from 495 495 ms to 34 34 ms ( Tab. 3 ).
Most of SolarWM’s latency is waiting for controls from the same 12 12 -frame block, so at 16 16 fps a control waits up to 688 688 ms before generation even begins.
A one-latent block would still wait 3 3 frames, and our experiments find finetuning SolarWM to one-latent blocks hurts performance (App. B.5 ).
Frame-wise generation lowers throughput, since every frame has its own tokens: PixVid needs about 3 × 3\times SolarWM’s DiT FLOPs per frame and runs at 29.4 29.4 vs. 72.0 72.0 fps, but both models exceed their base Wan model’s native 16 16 fps, so both stream in real time.
SolarWM’s extra throughput cannot shorten its control-to-screen latency.
blocks.zh:

一个一相通区块仍然会等3个3个帧,我们的实验发现将SolarWM微调为一相通区块会损害性能(App. B.
以框架为导向的生成降低了吞吐量,因为每个帧都有自己的符号: 像素 维德每帧大约需要3×3\times SolarWM的DiT FLOP并运行于29.4 29.4对72.0 72.0 fps,但两种型号都超过了其基数. Wan模型的原生地为16个16英尺高,所以两条溪流都是实时的.
SolarWM的额外吞吐量不能缩短其控制到屏幕的空闲度.

PixVid follows abrupt turns more closely (Turn 0.95 0.95 vs. 0.70 0.70 ; Fig. 7 ), since it receives a camera pose for every frame, whereas SolarWM receives one per four-frame latent.
Its FVD is comparable to SolarWM’s ( 51.1 51.1 vs. 53.8 53.8 ), while its camera rotation and translation errors are higher ( 5.44 ∘ 5.44^{\circ} vs. 4.24 ∘ 4.24^{\circ} and 0.312 0.312 vs. 0.231 0.231 ).
This is likely due to drift accumulated over a longer sequence of poses. Indeed, at 21 21 frames our errors are comparable to SolarWM’s ( Tab. 9 ). Mitigating such drift is an active area of research, so we leave it to future work.

PixVid跟随突起转速更近(Turn 0.95 0.95 vs. 0.70 0.70;图7),因为它每帧都得到相机姿势,而SolarWM每四帧得到一帧潜入.
其FVD可与SolarWM相媲美(51.1 51.1 vs 53.8 53.8),而其相机旋转和翻译出错则较高(5.44 ∘ 5.44 ^{\crc} vs 4.24 ∘ 4.24 ^{\crc}和 0.312 0.312 vs. 0.231 0.231.).
这可能是由在较长的姿势序列中累积而来。 事实上,21分时我们的错误与SolarWM(表9)相似。 减缓这种漂移现象是一个积极的研究领域,所以我们把它留给今后的工作去处理.

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.6 读取研究

blocks.en:
Setup. All ablations finetune Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B for 10 10 K iterations and change one design choice at a time from our final recipe: the convolutional head, 𝒙 \bm{x} -prediction, and shift.
We generate one video for each of 119 119 VBench prompts and measure the artifact that each choice targets using three reference-free metrics defined in App. B.6 : Seam, discontinuities along the patch grid; Noise, the per-pixel noise level; and Flicker, noise that changes from frame to frame.
The noise shift decides how training and sampling are spread across noise levels, which affects global structure as well as local noise, so we score the shift sweep on VBench, with all 946 946 prompts and one video per prompt.
blocks.zh:
设相. 将万2.1-T2V-1.3B修改为10个 K 重迭, 并一次从最终食谱中改变一个设计选择: 相接头, x\bm{x} - 预测, 并转向 。
我们用App中定义的3个无参考度量标准,为119个V Bench各生成一个视频提示并测量每个选择对象的文物。 B.6:接合,沿补丁网格不连续;噪声,每像素噪声水平;和Flicker,从相框到相框变化的噪声.
噪音变化决定了培训和采样如何分布在噪音水平之间,这影响了全球结构以及局部噪音,因此我们在V Bench上得分,所有946 946个提示和每个提示一个视频.

blocks.en:
Results. Output head. A linear head maps each DiT token to its pixel patch independently, so the head itself does not make neighboring patches agree at their borders, and the patch grid stays visible
(Fig. 8 ).
Our convolutional head, whose kernels span patch borders, lowers the seam measure from 118.6 118.6 to 13.3 13.3 .
The U-Net head, which additionally encodes the noisy input, reaches a similar seam ( 9.2 9.2 ) with slightly higher noise ( 0.848 0.848 vs. 0.777 0.777 ) and flicker ( 0.429 0.429 vs. 0.406 0.406 ), and it has 5.6 × 5.6\times more parameters ( 248 248 M vs. 44 44 M at 1.3 1.3 B), so we use the decoder-only head.
blocks.zh:
结果。 输出头. 每个 DiT 符号的独立像素补丁的线性头图,所以头本身不会让相邻的补丁在边界上达成一致,补丁网格保持可见
(图8).
我们的革命头,他的内核 跨越了补丁边界,降低 接合量从118.6 118.6到13.3 13.3
U-Net头又将噪音输入编码为相近的接合(9.2 9.2),发出稍高的噪声(0.848 0.848 vs. 0.777 0.777)和闪烁(0.429 0.429 vs. 0406 0406),它有5.6×5.6等参数(248 248 M vs 44.44 M at 1.3 B),所以我们只使用解码头.

Prediction target. As shown in Fig. 9 , 𝒗 \bm{v} -prediction with our head fills the video with flickering high-frequency noise at 80 80 times the noise level of 𝒙 \bm{x} -prediction, because predicting velocity requires the network to reproduce the per-pixel noise of its input.

We therefore use s = 15 s=15 , giving an effective shift of 3.97 3.97 under scale c = 3.78 c=3.78 . For the other models we keep a similar effective shift: s = 11 s=11 for the 14B model gives an effective shift of 3.86 3.86 under c = 2.85 c=2.85 , and at 960 × 1664 960\times 1664 we double both the shift and the calibration.

blocks.en:
Sampler. Latent video models, including Wan2.1, typically sample with UniPC [ 101 ] , which works well with a bf16 sampler state in latent space.
In pixel space, a bf16 state makes UniPC drain color, keeping only 91 % 91\% of the fp32 chroma, whereas Euler keeps it without needing an fp32 state ( Fig. 10 ). We suspect pixel space colors are more sensitive to higher order samplers. We therefore use the Euler sampler and leave further analysis to future work.
blocks.zh:
标本者. 包括Wan2.1在内的Latent视频模型,一般与UniPC [101] 的样本,在潜在空间中与bf16采样器状态良好.
在像素空间中, bf16 状态使 UniPC 排出色,仅保留了 fp32 铬的91% 91% ,而 Euler 保留了它而不需要 fp32 状态(图 10). 我们怀疑像素空间的颜色 对更高排序的采样者更敏感 因此,我们使用欧拉取样器,并将进一步的分析留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Latent video diffusion models compress video in space and time with a VAE.
PixVid removes this compression by efficiently finetuning a pretrained latent model to generate every frame directly in pixels, reaching quality competitive with the original model.
Working frame by frame in pixels, it overcomes three structural limitations of latent models: resolution scaling, control alignment under fast motion, and control-to-screen latency.
blocks.zh:
Lateent视频传播模型用一款VAE来压缩时空视频.
PixVid通过高效地微调预先训练出的潜在模型来去除这种压缩,以像素直接生成每个帧,达到与原始模型的质量竞争.
按像素排列的工作框架克服了潜在模型的三个结构局限性:分辨率缩放,快动下的控制对接,以及控制到屏幕的空闲.

blocks.en:
Limitations and future work. Without temporal compression, PixVid processes 3.9 × 3.9\times as many tokens per second of video as Wan2.1 at 480 × 832 480\times 832 , so short low-resolution clips cost more than with a latent model, although the gap closes at higher resolution and streaming stays faster than real time (App. B.7 ).
Generating directly in pixels also opens up training options that a frozen VAE rules out. Losses and rewards can be defined on pixels, enabling adversarial training and RL with pixel-space rewards. Because all models then share the same output space, distillation across architectures or from mixed teachers also becomes possible.
blocks.zh:
限制和今后的工作。 没有时间压缩,PixVid处理3.9×3.9\times每秒的视频比Wan2.1在480×832 480\times 832时多,因此低分辨率短片段比用潜入模型要花多,虽然在高分辨率时差距会收紧并流出时间会比实时快(App.B.7).
在像素中直接生成也开启了被冻结的VAE排除的训练选项. 损失和奖励可以在像素上定义,使对抗性训练和RL具有像素-空间奖励. 因为所有模型然后都拥有相同的输出空间,所以跨建筑或从混合教师那里蒸馏也成为可能.

blocks.en:
The detailer head replaces the linear output head and the VAE decoder of the pretrained latent model, mapping DiT features directly to pixels (Fig. 11 ). Its input is the last DiT hidden state 𝒔 \bm{s} on the token grid of size H / p × W / p H/p\times W/p with width D D . We add the timestep embedding 𝒆 t \bm{e}_{t} to 𝒔 \bm{s} , apply a SiLU, and project the result with a 3 × 1 × 1 3\times 1\times 1 bottleneck convolution. A stack of Up Blocks then upsamples the features to the full resolution H × W H\times W , and a final 3 × 1 × 1 3\times 1\times 1 convolution outputs the pixel prediction 𝒙 ^ \hat{\bm{x}} .
Since the head upsamples only spatially, it keeps the temporal resolution of the token grid.
Each Up Block doubles the spatial resolution, so a 1 × 16 × 16 1\times 16\times 16 patch requires 4 4 Up Blocks, with widths C 4 , … , C 1 C_{4},\dots,C_{1} .

blocks.en:
The training data are 79 79 K stock videos ( 74 % 74\% ground-level, 26 % 26\% aerial) with captions and Video Depth Anything [ 16 ] depth, as 21 21 -frame windows at 16 16 fps and 480 × 832 480\times 832 .
The latent baseline, VACE-1.3B [ 43 ] , passes both video and depth through the Wan2.1 VAE.
For PixVid, we convert Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B to pixel space ( 20 20 K iterations) and add VACE’s control branch, without the LPIPS loss.
Both models are finetuned for 10 10 K iterations, taking about 8 8 hours for PixVid and 5 5 for the latent model, and are sampled with the same caption and seed per clip.
Per 21 21 -frame clip, PixVid’s DiT processes 32,760 32{,}760 tokens per pass against the latent model’s 9,360 9{,}360 , or 7.0 × 7.0\times the FLOPs ( 28.3 28.3 vs. 4.1 4.1 PFLOPs over 100 100 passes, excluding the control branch).
The zero-shot Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-Control and Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control models use ZoeDepth input maps, and Cosmos-Transfer2.5 completed 962 962 of the 1,000 1{,}000 clips.

两个型号均被微调为10个克迭代,PixVid大约需要8个小时,而潜在型号则需要5个小时,每个片段的标注和种子都相同。

blocks.en:
Both 4 4 -step students stream 81 81 frames at 480 × 864 480\times 864 and 16 16 fps from a first frame, a caption, and a camera path.
SolarWM is the official SolarWM-5B student [ 37 ] , which uses the Wan2.2 VAE with 4 × 4\times temporal compression.
For PixVid, we lift the bidirectional base with patch size 32 32 , matching its VAE’s 16 × 16\times spatial compression and 2 × 2 2\times 2 DiT patch, and distill it with Self Forcing [ 38 ] for 3 3 K iterations with a noisy KV cache, keeping the 4 4 sink frames clean.
Both students are compared with EMA weights.
As references, we also evaluate the bidirectional latent base at 50 50 steps and Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 85 ] without camera input.
